objective: Produce truthful evidence of deploying and supporting an AI workflow for a real external consenting user, collaborator, team, or organization through discovery, deployment, feedback, iteration, and handoff.
truth_rules: Never fabricate a customer, user, testimonial, adoption event, or business outcome.
Use the exact relationship label: customer only if they are actually a customer; otherwise say pilot user, collaborator, tester, team, or organization.
Do not count the operator's own use as external adoption evidence.
Do not publish identities, quotes, screenshots, or usage details without permission.

evidence: repeat-use or explicit acceptance when available

acceptance: A real external participant exists and their relationship is labeled accurately.
Discovery artifacts predate or clearly precede the final solution.
A deployed workflow is actually exercised by the external participant.
At least one feedback-to-change loop is documented.
Acceptance, repeat use, or explicit outcome evidence is captured without inventing metrics.
A public-safe case study is created only from information permitted for publication.
Evidence is ingested into evidence-sources.json with limitations and source lineage.
claim_ceiling: Evidence supports only the exact external relationship and observed deployment/adoption behavior. It does not imply enterprise scale, revenue impact, or customer success beyond the recorded scope.
